author: blu
body: Proves an ability-granting Aura confers evasion in combat. The AI enchants its 2/2 bear with Black Ward ("Enchanted creature has protection from black"). The protection is not on the creature's own template -- it comes from the attached Aura -- so effective-abilities reads it, and a black creature can no longer block the enchanted bear. Before the Aura, the same black creature could block it.
